what makes this recipe healthier? 
while we haven’t completely excluded cream and butter ( because .. well life :) ), we have significantly reduced the quanitites to create a balanced dish packed with flavour but lower on the calories.
each portion of dal clocks in at around 230 calories per serving! 

When it comes to weekday meals, the key is to find something that’s both simple to prepare and satisfying to eat. This healthy dal makhani recipe ticks both boxes. Made with lentils, kidney beans, tomatoes, and a blend of spices, it’s packed with protein, fiber, and flavor. And when served over steamed rice, it’s a complete and nutritious meal that will keep you energized throughout the afternoon!! 

also, did you know dal makhani always tastes better the next day!!! 

Happy Friday :)
